Approval.description:
The human's decision on a draft (5.3). Comes from OUTSIDE the agent (CLI, later the API):
untrusted input, so it is validated like any other boundary, and an edit is re-checked.

by.description: Who decided: a name, kept in the work order
by.title: By

Approval.title: Approval

Bucket.description: Allowed aggregation sizes. A fixed ladder (not free text) keeps caching and charts sane.
Bucket.title: Bucket

DraftStep.description: Either a draft (title, sop, warnings) or `failed` with the reasons.
DraftStep.title: DraftStep

ErrorOut.description: The body of every HTTPException with a text detail: {"detail": "..."}.
ErrorOut.title: ErrorOut

id.description: An id from the evidence list, e.g. 'F1', 'A2', 'D3'
id.title: Id

statement.description: What this evidence shows, in one sentence
statement.title: Statement

Hypothesis.description: The model's judgement, in a shape code can check (guardrails) before anyone reads it.

citations.description: The bracketed document references from the D lines, copied exactly, e.g. '[MAN-CMP-001 §5.2]'. Never an evidence id like 'F1' or 'D4'.
citations.title: Citations

evidence.description: The evidence ids this conclusion rests on
evidence.title: Evidence

needs_action.description: True if someone should do something on the machine
needs_action.title: Needs Action

next_check.description: The single most useful next step for the engineer
next_check.title: Next Check

root_cause.description: One sentence; for unknown: what is missing to decide
root_cause.title: Root Cause

Hypothesis.title: Hypothesis

HypothesizeStep.description: Either a hypothesis (category, confidence, root_cause) or `failed`.
HypothesizeStep.title: HypothesizeStep

question.description: What the engineer wants to know, e.g. "Is the compressor overheating?"
question.title: Question

InvalidRequestOut.description:
FastAPI's own 422 for a malformed request (pydantic's error list), as a model so it can
be combined with our own 422 bodies in one documented response.
InvalidRequestOut.title: InvalidRequestOut

MachineTile.description: One machine on the plant overview (7.2): MachineOut plus its ACTIVE alarms (not cleared).
MachineTile.title: MachineTile

PendingApproval.description:
What a paused run is waiting for (GET /runs/{id}): the draft and why the previous decision
was sent back. The same shape as the approval_required event.
PendingApproval.title: PendingApproval

PlantOverview.description: Everything the overview needs in ONE response: ten tiles, one request (not ten).
PlantOverview.title: PlantOverview

ReadingBucket.description: One aggregated point. min/max keep short spikes visible that the average would hide.
ReadingBucket.title: ReadingBucket

RunOut.description:
A run's current state (also after a restart: from the checkpointer). Use it to catch up
after a dropped stream.
RunOut.title: RunOut

RunSummary.description:
One run in a list (7.5: the approval queue). From the agent_runs table ONLY: the draft
lives in the checkpoint, and loading it for every row would be N+1 against Postgres; it is
loaded when a row is opened (GET /runs/{thread_id}).
RunSummary.title: RunSummary

safety.description: True for lockout, hold points (⚠ STOP) and safety checks
safety.title: Safety

sop_step.description: Where in the SOP this comes from, e.g. '§4 step 6'
sop_step.title: Sop Step

text.description: What to do, in the SOP's words where possible
text.title: Text

WorkOrderDraft.description: A DRAFT for a human to approve (5.3); never saved by the agent on its own.

duration.description: From the SOP's scope, e.g. '30 min'
duration.title: Duration

sop_ref.description: The SOP this order follows, e.g. 'SOP-CMP-005'
sop_ref.title: Sop Ref

staff.description: From the SOP's scope, e.g. '1 technician'
staff.title: Staff

verification.description: The SOP's acceptance criteria, in one or two lines
verification.title: Verification

WorkOrderDraft.title: WorkOrderDraft

WorkOrderDraftOut.description:
The draft as the API PUBLISHES it (7.4b). Two audiences, two models: WorkOrderDraft hides
the code-filled fields from the LLM's schema (SkipJsonSchema, 5.5a), which also hid them
from the API contract, so the dashboard couldn't type them. Here they are ordinary fields.

duration.description: From the SOP's scope, e.g. '30 min'
duration.title: Duration

sop_ref.description: The SOP this order follows, e.g. 'SOP-CMP-005'
sop_ref.title: Sop Ref

staff.description: From the SOP's scope, e.g. '1 technician'
staff.title: Staff

verification.description: The SOP's acceptance criteria, in one or two lines
verification.title: Verification

WorkOrderDraftOut.title: WorkOrderDraftOut

part_no.description: Exactly as in the SOP's parts table, e.g. 'AF-SC55-E'
part_no.title: Part No

get.description: Identify the service. Handy as a smoke test and for humans hitting the base URL.
Requests, failures, cache hits and per-model latency over the last `hours`.
Check that the API can reach Postgres. 200 when healthy, 503 when the DB is unreachable.

post.description: Open an incident for one machine: the thing an investigation is ABOUT.

Start investigating an incident. 202 Accepted: the run is ACCEPTED, not finished; watch it
at `events_url` (Server-Sent Events, GET, so the browser's EventSource can reconnect on its
own). Closing that stream does not stop the run.

429.description: All run slots busy: retry after the Retry-After header's seconds

get.description: All machines (optionally of one line), ordered by code.
One machine with its sensors and their normal operating ranges.

One machine's alarms in [start, end), newest first (7.3: the machine page's timeline).
`truncated` + `total_count` say when the list is cut: then the EARLIEST alarms (when the
problem started) are the ones missing.

parameters.description: At most this many, newest first
parameters.name: limit

schema.description: At most this many, newest first
schema.title: Limit

422.description: Malformed request, or an invalid range / limit

get.description: Readings of one sensor aggregated per time bucket (avg / min / max / count).

422.description: Malformed request, or an invalid time range

get.description:
All machines by line with their ACTIVE alarms (count, worst severity, newest). The
dashboard polls this every few seconds: one request for the whole plant.

Runs, newest first (7.5). status=paused is the approval queue: runs whose draft waits
for a decision. A row has no draft: open it with GET /runs/{thread_id}.
A run's state: live from this process, or from the checkpointer (any process, a restart).

post.description:
Approve, edit or reject the draft a paused run is waiting on. Nothing is saved before
this, and an edited draft goes through the same safety checks as the model's draft.

409.description: The run is not waiting for a decision (already decided, or still running)

422.description: Sent back by the checks (the run stays paused), or a malformed body

get.description:
A run's events (7.4): step* (one per graph node), report, approval_required?, error?,
done, each with an id. Any number of readers; each gets everything so far (or what came
after its Last-Event-ID), then follows live until `done`. A run from before a restart:
a `notice`, then its result rebuilt from the checkpoint.
One work order with the complete document that was decided on.

post.description: Mark an APPROVED order as done, with who did it; the time is the server's.

409.description: This status change is not allowed (only approved -> done)
